criteria_outcomes.criterion: Map capabilities to needs without changing the stipulated need text.
Treat supplied corpus and capabilities as stipulated test inputs.

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage retained all allowed handoff records, preserved record_id and need as received from the needs handoff, and correctly produced no direct coverage because the received need values were source identifiers rather than capability need text. The upstream need corruption is not rooted here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Order unsupported needs first and otherwise preserve upstream ranking.

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize consumed coverage and evidence_sources, marked non-direct coverage as unsupported, and assigned priority ranks in upstream rank order. Its output is consistent with its inputs; the incorrect need values arrived through the needs handoff.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Produce the deterministic top-need recommendation and decision required by the execution contract.

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize retained eight priority rows and built the recommendation directly from the first ranked row. Given the supplied priorities, decision prioritize and top_need s01 are deterministic.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Select every qualifying demand row and preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields.
Map capabilities to needs without changing the stipulated need text.

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand selected all eight qualifying rows but did not preserve the corpus need field. It wrote need from source_id, producing s01 through s08 instead of the stipulated need text such as trace exact artifact handoffs between jobs. This is the first root cause that propagates through both handoffs and downstream outputs.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields from selected demand data.
Bound normalized needs to the allowed corpus identifiers and index window.

reviews.decision_reason: normalize preserved the selected dataframe columns it received, applied allowed record_id filtering, filled neutral sentinels, and bounded to eight rows. The incorrect need values were already present before this boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Assemble ranked source provenance with deterministic ordering.

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance sorted normalized needs deterministically by descending demand_score and record_id, then emitted record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank. The evidence_sources handoff hash is exact and consistent downstream.
